Name: Custom NPC - Lovino the werewolf
Author: sarazennko
Description:
***请配合狼人费里西安诺一起使用，费里西安诺是罗维诺的前置mod！！！
***USE IT WITH  FELICIANO, HE IS THE PRE-MOD FOR LOVINO!!

黑塔利亚罗维诺同人mod/  A FAN-MADE MOD OF FELICIANO IN HETALIA ( description by trans
星露谷物语自制有属性NPC狼人罗维诺

*该mod会添加狼人罗维诺npc于游戏中，[u]他会在夏天第一天来到镇上[/u]，和弟弟住在法师塔附近，平日在镇子上活动，晚上回到秘密森林入口睡觉懒到第二天。第一年夏日第一天他会登门拜访你，之后才能在游戏里见到他。他晚上会在格斯的酒吧打工。[u](如果触发事件后没有看到罗维诺或者他站在原地不动不进行任何行程属于正常现象，睡一两天就会正常运作）[/u]
This mod will add Lovino the werewolf to game . He lives in the Forest and moves around the town . [u]He will come to stardew vally at Summer 1st [/u].At nights he comes back to the Woods and sleep in until next day 9 am.[u]He will visit you on the first day of the first summer and then you can meet him in-game.[/u] He spends his evenings working at Saloon .[u]（If you don't see Lovino after the event is triggered, or if he stands still and doesn't make any trips, it's normal for a day or two to work）[/u]

*结婚可！私货设定如山注意！能力不足无好感剧情！零基础编程可能bug一堆注意！欢迎反馈意见和bug！
You can marry him . Don't mind some out of my personal preference parts of Lovino . There's NO HEARTS EVENTS in this mod because of my lack of programming ability . If there are  any bugs or suggestions just let me know!

*感谢三生Sarvente老师提供的模板（详见尾号18651）还有萌新（sindy1994）老师的编程指导，再次感谢！！
Special thanks to 三生Saevente for the templates ( see this at id18651 ) and programming guide by 萌新（sindy1994） , I would never see Lovino in stardewvalley without their help .
